general_information.Description: Reading skill Upon completion of the course, students should be able to: - Guess meaning from context - Make inferences - Indentify main ideas and supporting ideas through skimming and scanning - Distinguish facts from opinion - Identify pronoun references - Understand text organization - Understand patterns of organization - Understand figurative language - Recognize oganizational phrases - Take notes - Summarize - Understand paragraph transitions - Paraphrase -
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Access the course websites for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practice and assessment.
